title: Retail Locations – Nairobi, Nanyuki, Naivasha, Nakuru, Mombasa
content:
Available at Leading Retailers Nationwide

Find Your Pet's Favourite Food – Anywhere in Kenya

Our premium cat and dog food brands are available in over 400+ retail locations nationwide and growing every day. From Nairobi to Mombasa, Kisumu to Eldoret, Nanyuki, Naivasha, Nakuru, and everywhere in between, we're making premium pet nutrition more accessible for pet parents across Kenya.

Shop Conveniently Near You

You can find our products at trusted retailers including:

NAIVAS,
CARREFOUR,
CHANDARANA,
QUICKMART,
Neighborhood Supermarket,
Pet Boardings or,
Vet clinics.

If you don't see our products at your preferred store, simply get in touch with us and we'll do our best to make them available near you. Your pet's happiness and yours is always our priority.

Fast & Hassle-Free Home Delivery

Order your pet's favorite food online anytime, anywhere. Our online store offers a fast, secure, and seamless shopping experience. You can also place orders directly via WhatsApp at +254 795 350 292

Join Our Community: SUBSCRIBE to our email list. We'll make it worth your while with a FREE DELIVERY VOUCHER.
Have questions about delivery fees, payment methods, or operations? Visit our FAQs Page for quick answers.
Because we love them as much as you do!
